summary: Iter35 multi-industry modules end-to-end verified. Backend: 34/34 pytest in test_iter35_industry_modules.py PASS — all 4 industries (Hospitality, Transport, Healthcare, Retail) create+list records correctly, automated compliance logic verified (temp 3°C in_range vs 9°C breach with FSANZ Std 3.2.2 reason; 13h fatigue auto-breach; SIRS P1 'unexpected_death' triggers 24h deadline; NHVR auto-sets notify_nhvr_by 24h after occurred_at; lone-worker _overdue auto-computed; quick-induct status check). Cross-industry 403 hard-blocks verified for trades user across 8 endpoints (2 per industry). Trades regression intact: features/me, /swms/library, /incidents, /workers all 200. critical_code_review_comments: routes/hospitality.py, transport.py, healthcare.py, retail.py are clean self-contained modules registered via factory functions (server.py 2290-2320). Each gate uses Depends(require_feature(code)) which short-circuits the request before handler execution — gives consistent 403 (or 402 trial) for any non-matching industry. Verified.

Temperature log compliance logic correctly differentiates fridge/freezer/bain_marie thresholds per FSANZ Std 3.2.2 (COLD_MAX=5.0, FROZEN_MAX=-15.0, HOT_MIN=60.0). 3°C fridge → in_range=true, 9°C fridge → in_range=false with reason 'Cold storage must be ≤5.0°C (FSANZ Std 3.2.2)'.
NHVR endpoint auto-computes notify_nhvr_by = occurred_at + 24h. SIRS endpoint correctly classifies 'unexpected_death' into SIRS_PRIORITY_ONE → P1 24h deadline.

Brief lists field names like 'rego'/'category' but actual contracts use 'vehicle_rego'/'occurrence_type'/'declared_mass_kg'/'consumer_initials'/'care_type'/'party'/'screening_type'/'occurred_at' as required. Implementation is internally consistent; brief vs code is a minor doc drift only — no code fix needed.

Frontend IndustryListTab.jsx is a clean shared abstraction — list+inline-form side-by-side, with industry-themed accent colors injected per page. All 4 pages reuse it via tab routing. Verified renders cleanly across all 4 industries with theme-appropriate sidebar/badges (e.g., Retail page renders purple 'Start check-in window' button).
